_comment: P-3.213 UNPINNED ratchet (maintainer ruling 2026-10-27, option A), read by tools/lint-standards-currency.py (gate 6) on a default-scope run. Source, not generated: one entry per register Standard ID, the number of its citations that name no edition. A count may only fall. When a change pins citations, lower that standard's entry to the gate's live count in the same change, and remove it at 0; the gate fails while an entry is above or below the live count, above its value at the base revision, or new without the standard's new register row. Seeded from the live UNPINNED counts at dfbbe8eb4 (473 occurrences of 96 standards) plus one entry, ISO/IEC 20000-1: 1, created by the ISO/IEC 20000-1 register row added with the ratchet; then NIST CSF lowered from 11 to 10 on rebasing onto de3715476 (473 occurrences of 97 standards). The ISO/IEC 20000-1 count is the bare ISO/IEC 20000-1 inside the title of ISO/IEC TS 20000-11:2021 (operations/framework-it-service-management.md line 93), not a citation of 20000-1 itself; the gate counts it because its predicate has no title exemption, so the seed records what the gate counts.
